task:
FIX THE POSTGRESQL 18 TEST FAILURES INTRODUCED BY a518fad7 ON PR #817 (purge P1, migration 016).

Base: branch codex/run-38689108057-1 at a518fad7d6e32833157f8032d1ca075cacf6f654. The previous head 733b4988 passed the CI lane 'Finder derived-data tests (PostgreSQL 18)'. At a518fad7 that lane fails (job 116322951925) with these errors in tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py:

1. psycopg.errors.RaiseException: writer fence catalog or session drift, raised from v3_meta.purge_assert_fences (line 19 at RAISE), called from purge_record_event (line 22) and from purge_start_payload_batch (line 8).
2. pytest.fail('test operation never entered the authenticated cancellation state') in the new helper that waits for a lock-waiting VACUUM FULL using the pg_stat_activity + pg_locks query (wait_event_type='Lock', AccessExclusiveLock NOT granted on v3_derived.system_search).
3. psycopg.errors.RaiseException: competing writing transaction, raised from v3_meta.begin_derived_generation_purge (line 10).

Likely causes to check first: (a) the new lock-wait test may never reach the waiting state (wrong blocker, the VACUUM text not matching the regex, or the worker query not 'active'), and its failure may leave worker/blocker connections open, which then cascade into errors 1 and 3 in later tests; make the test deterministic and make sure every worker and blocker connection is closed or cancelled in a finally block. (b) The purge_open_event change that keeps WRITER_FENCE_ENABLED open until a WRITER_FENCE_RESTORED with verified=true may have changed fence or restore behaviour that existing tests rely on; confirm the intended rule (a writer fence stays open until restoration is verified) still holds without breaking the restore/verify flow.

Rules: keep every K1-K4 safety rule from a518fad7 (incoming-membership refusal on adoption; authenticated cancellation of a lock-waiting VACUUM FULL by recorded PID, backend_start, bounded command text and the exact ungranted AccessExclusiveLock on the recorded relation; no new REWRITE_STARTED or autovacuum fence after REWRITE_VERIFIED; one open SERVICES_QUIESCED and exact container set on restore). Do not weaken any assertion just to pass; fix the real cause. If you need to change migration 016's bytes, regenerate sql/v3/migration-manifest.txt, deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json (to_migration_set_identity, schema_identity_sha256, and the checksums in the evidence text) and the pinned values in tests/test_v3_system_search_production_operator.py using scripts/operator/v3_schema_identity.py, exactly as a518fad7 did. Update CHANGES.md only if the behaviour description changes.

If PostgreSQL 18 is available on the runner (docker or a local server), run tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py against a disposable database and report the result. Always run: ruff check .; python -m pytest -q tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py tests/test_v3_system_search_production_operator.py; python scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py --operation authority-gate.

Allowed files: sql/v3/migrations/016_v3_governed_derived_purge.sql, sql/v3/migration-manifest.txt, deploy/v3-production/target-authority.json, tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py, tests/test_v3_system_search_production_operator.py, CHANGES.md. No production operation.
